content:
Generate a 12-panel storyboard image first (16:9) with numbered scenes, captions, camera direction notes, and a clean white background to lock the fight progression before animating in Seedance 2.  
In the storyboard prompt, specify style + camera shot list (wide/medium/close-up, ringside, low angle, OTS, tracking, push-in/pull-back) to pre-plan cinematic coverage for the video.  
Upload the storyboard image as a character reference in Seedance 2 and instruct that fighters must match hairstyle, facial features, body type, and shorts style exactly to maintain consistency across the full 15s.  
Write the Seedance 2 video prompt with a timestamped timeline (e.g., 0–2s standoff, 2–4s jab-cross, 4–6s slow-mo impact, etc.) to control beats, pacing, and camera moves.  
Explicitly prompt camera behavior (cinematic handheld, dynamic tracking, slow push-ins, impact zooms, motion blur, shallow depth of field) to avoid static shots.  
Add a negative prompt targeting common failures (low quality, blurry, extra limbs/fingers, deformed anatomy, duplicate fighters, floating parts, static camera, text/watermark/logo, cropped body, exposure issues, glitch/distorted face, unrealistic movement).
